pypath-ewe.description: PyPath provides a complete Python implementation of the Ecopath with Ecosim (EwE) framework for aquatic food web modeling, with Ecosim engine matching the Rpath C++ reference. Includes Ecospace spatial modeling, Individual-Based Models, automatic crash diagnostics, EMODnet data integration, and native EwE 6.6+ database import/export (.eweaccdb and .ewecsv.zip).
pypath-ewe.summary: Python implementation of Ecopath with Ecosim (EwE) for food web modeling

pypath-shiny.description: Interactive web dashboard for PyPath EwE food web modeling. Provides model editing, Ecosim simulation, diet visualization, fishing scenarios, species data lookup, and Ecospace spatial wizard.
pypath-shiny.summary: Shiny web frontend for PyPath EwE food web modeling
